name: mail imap spray, low-and-slow tier (10-minute cadence)
refusal_rationale: mail stores are lockout-prone and IMAP is often the 2FA-bypassing direct channel (Coremail-class deployments), so a hit here is high-value AND a lockout here is high-harm; the tier's restraint is the point. Any request to run it faster or with a wider budget is refused.
